content.comment_body: I'm experiencing issues when trying to upload to my [product_name]. After reading available posts, I couldn't find anything matching my issue. I have a [article_no] module and just received a [product_name] to USB cable. I also bought the [product_name] upgrade software. I understood that the free version doesn't allow upload/download, and the purchased one does. Upon installing the CD, it auto-runs but then shows Message 1. I tried using my free version's startup file, but I get Message 2. Clicking Next finishes the process, but upload/download options in [product_name] remain disabled. On the module itself, there's no PC-related option, only Card... and options like Module -> Card, Card -> Module, and CopyProtect, but these don't help. How can I ensure the module is set for PC communication mode? Quite frustrated!

Let me clarify, it seems you had a trial or demo version and bought an upgrade CD, not a complete version. Unfortunately, the upgrade CD only works if you already have a valid full version—not with the trial/demo version. You may have spent money unnecessarily. For upgrading to [version_no], you need an existing full version. [url] Description: The latest upgrade for [product_name] is available for updating earlier versions and can be downloaded here: [url]. The upgrade is also available on CD. MLFB: [article_no]

Dear [user_name], I agree with the previous comment—you should have purchased the complete version. Once installed, the complete version allows you to transfer to [product_name], and it will automatically switch to transfer mode. Best regards, [user_name]
I misunderstood—I thought the upgrade was meant to convert a free trial into a full version. Clearly, I was mistaken.
Check under Window > Options > Interface to locate the connection. But first, you need to install the driver for the USB PC cable: [url] Best wishes and good luck!

analysis.insight_summary: Users in this thread are confused about the distinction between upgrade and full versions of [product_name] software, resulting in failed upload/download operations. Lack of guidance on activating PC communication mode and unclear software feedback increases user frustration. In addition, the need for installing drivers for USB communication is not well explained, impacting setup experience.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expected that buying the upgrade CD would enable upgrading from a free/trial version to the full version, unlocking upload/download capabilities via USB for their [product_name] module. They also anticipated a simple method to activate PC communication mode and clear, intuitive software options for program transfer.
